phases.instruction: Look at a neutral wall. Breathe normally. Eyes OPEN.
Eyes CLOSED. Breathe normally. Berger alpha-block standard.
Eyes OPEN. READ the CLM live output in your browser tab (anima local instance). Verbalize one observation per minute.
Eyes CLOSED. Subtract 7 from 1000 serially (1000, 993, 986, ...). Cognitive load CONTROL — CLM unrelated.
Eyes CLOSED. Count breaths 1-10 cyclically. Mindfulness CONTROL.
Eyes OPEN. Silent rest. No task.

marker_outlet_spec.name: anima_phase_marker
marker_emit_points: <phase_id>_START at the boundary of each 5-min phase (t=0,300,600,900,1200,1500)

phase_runner_source:
PASTE_BELOW_INTO_/tmp/n1_bridge_realtime/phase_runner.sh AND chmod +x:

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# N-1 BRIDGE v2 real-time phase runner. Mac-side. Emits LSL phase markers + voice/visual prompts.
set -euo pipefail

MARKER_HELPER="$HOME/n1_bridge_realtime/emit_marker.py"
mkdir -p "$HOME/n1_bridge_realtime"

# Inline-write the marker helper so the runner is self-contained.
cat > "$MARKER_HELPER" <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys, time
from pylsl import StreamInfo, StreamOutlet, local_clock
from pathlib import Path

STATE_FILE = Path.home() / 'n1_bridge_realtime' / 'marker_outlet.pid'

def get_or_create_outlet():
    info = StreamInfo('anima_phase_marker', 'Markers', 1, 0, 'string', 'anima_phase_marker_v1')
    return StreamOutlet(info)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print('usage: emit_marker.py <marker_value> [hold_sec]', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(2)
    marker = sys.argv[1]
    hold = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 0.5
    outlet = get_or_create_outlet()
    time.sleep(0.2)  # ensure consumers latch
    outlet.push_sample([marker], local_clock())
    print(f'[marker] {marker}', file=sys.stderr)
    time.sleep(hold)
PYEOF
chmod +x "$MARKER_HELPER"

say_or_echo() {
  if command -v say >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    say "$1" &
  fi
  printf '\n=== %s ===\n' "$1"
}

emit() {
  python3 "$MARKER_HELPER" "$1" 0.5
}

emit SESSION_START
say_or_echo "Session start. Phase one: eyes open baseline. Five minutes."
emit P1_OPEN_START; sleep 300

emit P2_CLOSED_START
say_or_echo "Phase two: eyes closed. Berger response. Five minutes."
sleep 300

emit P3_CLM_READ_START
say_or_echo "Phase three: open eyes, read C L M live output in your browser. Verbalize one observation per minute."
sleep 300

emit P4_ARITHMETIC_START
say_or_echo "Phase four: eyes closed. Serial seven subtract from one thousand. Five minutes."
sleep 300

emit P5_BREATH_START
say_or_echo "Phase five: eyes closed. Breath focus. Count one to ten cyclically. Five minutes."
sleep 300

emit P6_RECOVERY_START
say_or_echo "Phase six: open eyes, silent rest. Five minutes."
sleep 300

emit SESSION_END
say_or_echo "Session complete. Stop LabRecorder and save the X D F file."
user_invocation: /tmp/n1_bridge_realtime/phase_runner.sh   # 30 minutes blocking; use 'caffeinate -i' wrapper if desired

smoke_test.purpose: Confirm marker outlet visible to LabRecorder before the real session
smoke_test.command: python3 ~/n1_bridge_realtime/emit_marker.py SMOKE_TEST 5.0 &  python3 -c "from pylsl import resolve_byprop, StreamInlet; s=resolve_byprop('name','anima_phase_marker',timeout=8); i=StreamInlet(s[0]); print(i.pull_sample(timeout=4.0))"

honest_notes: macOS 'say' command provides voice cues; if disabled, fall back to terminal echo only
P3 (CLM-read) requires user to actually engage with CLM output; if browser tab is closed, manipulation fails — this is the ONLY phase where coupling is theoretically expected
P4 (arithmetic) is the matched cognitive-load control for P3; both impose effort but only P3 has CLM signal exposure
Marker StreamInfo nominal_srate=0 marks it as irregular (LSL convention for event streams)
